page.layout: One text column; small illegible marginal notes at the top right and a few marks in the right margin. Running head at the top, page number at the top right.

main_text.p: controuersia. Lex enim Porcia ciuem indemnatum necari uetat. Senatusconsultum autem factum erat, uiderent Cos. ne quid Respub. detrimenti caperet. Intentio: Iniuria, & contra legem Porciam Gracchum occidisti. D. Iure occidi. Q. Iuréne, an iniuria occiderit? R. Salutis enim omnium & Reipub. conseruandae causa feci. F. At ne scelera[?]tissimum quidem ciuem sine iudicio, iure ullo necare potuisti. D. Potuerit ne recte salutis reipub. causa ciué [?] euer[?] forē ciuitatis indēnatū necare? Respōdetur, propter S. C. posse. legi enim Porciae per se[illegible, ~8 letters]

page.notes: Page number read as 195 but the final digit is uncertain; it may be 191. The lower-case marks in the right margin are too faint to read and are not transcribed. Words marked [?] are doubtful: "scelera[?]tissimum" (a line-end break without a visible hyphen), and "euer" in "ciué euer". The first word is a continuation from the page before, and the paragraph runs on to the bottom of the text block, where the last line ends with "se".
